item.description:
This maintenance release fixes two file-pane interaction bugs: double-clicking
a row when several items are selected, and dragging files again after a drop
completes.

### Fixes

- Double-clicking a row now opens the item under the pointer even when multiple
  rows are selected, including `..` after Select All. Double-clicking a column
  header no longer opens a selected item.
- Dragging files from a pane continues to start new drags after a completed
  drop (including drops inside Portside and into other apps), instead of
  falling back to selecting rows.

### Known limitations

- Search matches filenames only, returns the first 200 matches, and stays on
  its starting volume. It does not follow symbolic links or descend into packages.
- Regex matching is case-insensitive by default; inline flags can change it.
  Invalid or excessively expensive expressions stop with an editable error.
- Search is unavailable on SFTP tabs while recursive remote search is deferred.
  Typing directly in an SFTP pane still filters its current folder.
